column1: Hermana Maria Louisa, estoy muy feliz de estar aquí en tu presencia,
column2: Sister Maria Louisa, I am very happy to be here in your presence,

column1: y quiero hacerte una pregunta basada en el primer libro de John Veres 5-9.
column2: and I want to ask you a question based on the first book of John Veres 5-9.

column1: Mi pregunta es, o las preguntas: ¿qué significa tener comunión con él,
column2: My question is, or the questions: what does it mean to have fellowship with him,

column1: ¿y qué significa tener comunión entre sí?
column2: and also what does it mean to have fellowship with each other?

column1: Por favor explíquenos, Hermana, lo que significa tener comunión con Dios: esto es estar con Dios,
column2: Please explain to us, Sister, what that means to have fellowship with God: this to be with God,

column1: vivir con él, caminar con él. ¿Y cómo sabemos que estamos caminando con Dios?
column2: live with him, walk with him. And how do we know that we are walking with God?

column1: ¿Cómo sabemos que tenemos a Dios? Porque nuestras obras, nuestros hechos, nos dicen que estamos con él,
column2: How do we know that we have God? Because our works, our Deeds, tell us that we are with him,

column1: porque aprendimos su palabra, creímos en él, vimos o vemos sus mandamientos,
column2: because we learned his word, we believed in him, we saw or are seeing his Commandments,

column1: y nos hemos separado. Y al separarnos, entonces nos ha dado su espíritu santo.
column2: and we have set ourselves apart. And by setting ourselves apart, then he has given us his holy spirit.

column1: Nos promete. Bueno, se manifiesta de manera extraordinaria en nuestras vidas.
column2: He makes promises to us. Well, he manifests himself in an extraordinary way in our lives.

column1: Él nos habla a través de sueños, visiones, Apocalipsis, profecía, realiza milagros, ha sanado, ha dado paz
column2: He speaks to us through dreams, Visions, Revelations, prophecy, performs miracles, has healed, has given peace

column1: y felicidad a la gente. Eso nos hace saber que estamos caminando con Dios, que tenemos a Dios.
column2: and happiness to people. That makes us know that we are walking with God, that we have God.

column1: Así que cuando estoy con Dios, siempre intento agradarle en todo: tener misericordia de las personas,
column2: So when I am with God, I am always trying to please him in everything: to have mercy on people,

column1: compasión, amor a la gente, ayudar a la gente, orar por ellos. Entonces cuando lo hago, también es tener Fellowship.
column2: compassion, love people, help people, pray for them. Then when I do that, it is also to have Fellowship.

column1: Todos estamos en Fellowship porque creemos en lo mismo.
column2: We are all in Fellowship because we believe in the same thing.

column1: Estamos creyendo en un Dios que se manifiesta en espíritu.
column2: We are believing in a God who manifests himself in spirit.

column1: Creemos en el dios del que habla la Biblia.
column2: We are believing in the god the Bible speaks of.

column1: Estamos aquí buscándolo, aprendiendo. Esa es Fellowship. Eso está teniendo Fellowship.
column2: We are here seeking him, learning. That is Fellowship. That is having Fellowship.

column1: Creo en lo que crees, y sabes por qué creo.
column2: I believe in what you believe, and you know why I believe.

column1: También creo en las cosas en las que crees, porque todos estamos aquí.
column2: I also believe in the things that you believe in, because we are all here.

column1: Tenemos Fellowship porque mis conceptos son tus Conceptos. Mi manera de amar a Dios es la misma manera que amas a Dios.
column2: We have Fellowship because my concepts are your Concepts. My way of loving God is the same way you love God.

column1: Mi deseo de agradar a Dios es su deseo de agradar a Dios también. Eso es comunión.
column2: My desire to please God is your desire to please God as well. That is fellowship.

column1: Eso es comunión: que estamos de acuerdo. Estamos de acuerdo en muchas cosas.
column2: That is fellowship: that we agree. We agree on many things.

column1: Tenemos Fellowship. Nos comunicamos mutuamente, eso es todo, nos comunicamos mutuamente.
column2: We have Fellowship. We communicate mutually, that's it, we communicate mutually.

column1: Tú también quieres seguir a Dios. Esa es la beca.
column2: You want to follow God, me too. That is the fellowship.

column1: Y entonces es lo mismo con Dios. El Señor quiere que seamos buenos.
column2: And then it is the same thing with God. The Lord wants us to be good, just.

column1: ¿Y por qué? Porque es bueno y justo. Esa es la beca.
column2: And why? Because he is good and just. That is the fellowship.

column1: Ahí es donde nos comunicamos, y tenemos el mismo sentimiento, el mismo pensamiento, el mismo amor,
column2: That's where we communicate, and we have the same feeling, the same thought, the same love,

column1: el mismo amor que Dios tiene para todos. Bueno, entonces también debería sentirlo por ti.
column2: the same love that God has for everyone. Well then, I should also feel it for you.

column1: Eso es lo que se llama tener comunión con Dios y compañerismo entre sí.
column2: That is what is called having fellowship with God and fellowship with each other.
